description: Source code for graphical spawn entities in the Unvanquished game, including particle systems, light flares, portals, animated models, and shader modifications.

methods.name: gfx_particle_system_toggle
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of a particle system by toggling EF_NODRAW flag.

methods.name: gfx_particle_system_act
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the particle system and sets up next think time if needed.

methods.name: SP_gfx_particle_system
methods.description: Initializes a particle system entity, setting origin, angles, model index, and spawn flags.

methods.name: gfx_light_flare_toggle
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of a light flare.

methods.name: findEmptySpot
methods.description: Finds an empty spot near a given origin within a specified radius for visibility testing.

methods.name: SP_gfx_light_flare
methods.description: Initializes a light flare entity, setting shader, position, and visibility.

methods.name: gfx_portal_locateCamera
methods.description: Locates and configures a portal camera's position, orientation, and target.

methods.name: SP_gfx_portal_surface
methods.description: Initializes a portal surface entity, setting size, linking, and camera location.

methods.name: SP_gfx_portal_camera
methods.description: Initializes a portal camera entity, setting size and linking.

methods.name: gfx_animated_model_act
methods.description: Activates or deactivates an animated model based on spawn flags.

methods.name: SP_gfx_animated_model
methods.description: Initializes an animated model entity, setting animations, model, and spawn flags.

methods.name: gfx_shader_mod_act
methods.description: Applies a shader remap if conditions are met.

methods.name: SP_gfx_shader_mod
methods.description: Initializes a shader modification entity, setting activation and reset functions.
